title: HEAD HUNTING PROGRAM INVITATION
lines: Yostar Games warmly welcomes you to apply to our Head Hunting Program. We thank you in advance for the interest you have in our game and the content you are producing for it.

With the purpose of helping our content creators, we have set up a creator program that will help our current and future content creators to gain visibility by helping them to create better content, receive supports from a team of professionals .
In short, what are we intending to do?
- Help the participants to grow their channel and audience.
- Reward participants with monthly benefits
- Reward participants with special merchandises
- Set up a special discord channel with the coordinators and other participants.
- The list is not limited to the above-mentioned points and can be updated at any time .
Requirements:
Applicants must possess a YouTube channel or Twitch channel and publish content related to Arknights on such a channel.
Applicants must have at least 2,000 subscribers for their YouTube channel (or 2,000 followers for their Twitch channel).
Applicants must have at least 5 videos related to Arknights EN on their channel.
The content of all videos for this event should be 100% original . Failure to follow this rule will result in immediate disqualification.

All videos should not contain elements of politics, violence, pornography, grotesque, controversial, or any other topic restricted by the platform, as well as materials that may involve copyright infringement. Failure to follow these indications may result in disqualification.
How to apply?
Applicants can fill in the required information within Google Form via the link below, and submit it to apply for the program.
Application Link: https://forms.gle/xiSMJBRbmhNXjjGD8
The following information is required in the form:
[Name]
[Contact E-mail]
[Brief introduction of your Channel]
[Link to your own YouTube or Twitch channel]
[Proof(s) for the ownership of submitted channel(Recommended: a screenshot of the homepage of your channel)]
Review

Once the application is received, there will be a review process (Within 3 workdays) . If the application does not meet the requirements above or violates any rules mentioned above, it will not be accepted. Applicants will receive a notification email via their contact email address to inform them of the result of their application. Applicants who are accepted will receive an invitation email for further details.
Note

By applying to the Head Hunting Program, you hereby certify that all the information you provide in your application is truthful and accurate. Arknights EN will not take any responsibility for any issue caused by inaccurate or incomplete information. Arknights EN will contact creators via arknights.en.hh@yo-star.com only.
If you have any questions regarding the Headhunting program, feel free to contact us by sending emails to arknights.en.hh@yo-star.com as well.
